import urllib.request
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import html, re

FEEDS = [
    ("Google News – AI",          "https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=artificial+intelligence&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en"),
    ("Google News – LLMs/Models", "https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=ChatGPT+OR+Gemini+OR+Claude+OR+LLM+OR+GPT&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en"),
    ("AI News (artificialintelligence-news.com)", "https://www.artificialintelligence-news.com/feed/"),
    ("MIT News – AI",             "https://news.mit.edu/rss/topic/artificial-intelligence2"),
    ("VentureBeat – AI",          "https://venturebeat.com/category/ai/feed/"),
]

def clean(text):
    text = html.unescape(text or "")
    text = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", "", text)
    return text.strip()[:280]

all_items = []

for feed_name, url in FEEDS:
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 AI-News-Fetcher/1.0"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as resp:
            raw = resp.read()
        root = ET.fromstring(raw)
        # Handle both RSS and Atom
        ns = {"atom": "http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom"}
        items = root.findall(".//item") or root.findall(".//atom:entry", ns)
        print(f"\n{'='*60}")
        print(f"SOURCE: {feed_name}  ({len(items)} items)")
        print(f"{'='*60}")
        for item in items[:10]:
            title   = clean(item.findtext("title") or item.findtext("atom:title", namespaces=ns))
            pub     = clean(item.findtext("pubDate") or item.findtext("atom:published", namespaces=ns))
            link    = clean(item.findtext("link") or "")
            desc    = clean(item.findtext("description") or item.findtext("atom:summary", namespaces=ns) or "")
            source  = clean(item.findtext("source") or "")
            print(f"  TITLE : {title}")
            if source: print(f"  SOURCE: {source}")
            print(f"  DATE  : {pub}")
            print(f"  LINK  : {link}")
            if desc: print(f"  DESC  : {desc}")
            print()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"\n[ERROR] {feed_name}: {e}")
